title: Kawamata's K-Equivalence Implies D-Equivalence Conjecture
exact_target: Do smooth projective varieties whose canonical divisors agree after birational pullback necessarily have equivalent derived categories of coherent sheaves?

sources.citation: Yujiro Kawamata, “D-Equivalence and K-Equivalence,” Journal of Differential Geometry 61 (2002), arXiv:math/0205287v3.
